d: UP Yoddha became the second team to qualify for the VIVO Pro Kabaddi Season 8 playoffs after defeating U Mumba by 7 points in Match 124. Surender Gill and Pardeep Narwal scored 14 combined raid points for the side as UP made it to the playoffs for a fourth-consecutive season.
